description:
## Goal

Improve test coverage and reliability for the web-console continuous audio system. After fixing the VAD and summarization bugs, ensure the entire audio pipeline has robust tests that prevent regressions.

## Scope

### Voice Input Testing
- Expand VAD tests with outdoor noise profiles (wind, traffic, crowd noise patterns)
- Add persistent mode segment boundary detection tests with realistic audio level sequences
- Test WebSocket streaming reconnection and fallback to HTTP batch
- Test speaker verification accept/reject flows
- Add integration tests for the full voice input pipeline: mic → VAD → transcription → segment-final

### TTS Output Testing
- Add integration tests for the summarization pipeline: event → summarize → cache → broadcast
- Test Kokoro → browser TTS fallback chain
- Test pre-synthesis caching with version switching (summarized vs. original)
- Test markdown normalization edge cases (deeply nested code blocks, large tables, mixed content)
- Test paragraph splitting boundary conditions (exactly 4500 chars, sentence boundary detection)

### End-to-End Testing
- Test the full loop: agent response hook → conversation event → TTS pre-synthesis → summarization → client broadcast → playback
- Test auto-TTS on tab switch (catch-up + immediate paths)
- Test configuration changes mid-session

## Existing Test Inventory

34 test files already exist across frontend and backend. This item focuses on filling gaps identified during the VAD and summarization bug fixes, not rewriting existing tests.

## Key Files

- Frontend tests: `scenarios/web-console/ui/src/hooks/voice/*.test.ts`, `scenarios/web-console/ui/src/hooks/tts/*.test.ts`
- Backend tests: `scenarios/web-console/api/*_test.go` (tts_*, voice_*)

title: Harden Test Coverage and Reliability for Continuous Audio Features
